1.text: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

4.text: And who brings out the pasture

6.text: We will make you recite, [O Muḥammad], and you will not forget,

7.text: Except what Allāh should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

8.text: And We will ease you toward ease.<sup foot_note="228222">1</sup>

footnotes.228222: - To the path of Allāh's religion, which is easy and natural, or toward Paradise, by giving opportunities for righteous deeds.

9.text: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;<sup foot_note="228223">1</sup>

footnotes.228223: - i.e., wherever it will be heard and understood.

10.text: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.

11.text: But the wretched one will avoid it –

12.text: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

14.text: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

15.text: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

16.text: But you prefer the worldly life,

17.text: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

18.text: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

19.text: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
